parser_ownership: Whole-source success and refusal release every memo shard value; traced refusals retain their result before clearing memo and trace values. Native parse-release frames report shard count and elapsed milliseconds.
cold_cli_stack_sample: One-second native sample while compiling sealed CLI source: string interning and evaluator frames dominate the sampled main-thread work. Interning hashes complete byte strings before candidate comparison. This is a sampled location of cost, not per-Form-function timing or proof of an optimization.
scope: Native lowering of this unit and its discovered contracts; host activity varied. This is not a whole-build or assembly-quality benchmark. The active compilation input owns recipe reuse; changed input explicitly clears prior recipe values. The seed retains record keys. Reuse is not persistent across processes or relocated snapshots, and full-build memory improvement is not established.
